name: Gaoth Eyes
body:
Your keen eyes are adept at spotting the best deals.

Prerequisite(s): Gaoth, Appraise 3 ranks

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 racial bonus on any Appraise checks to determine the value of items and to Spellcraft checks to identify the properties of magical equipment.
